name: -6 AN to M10x1.5mm Metric Adapter
title: -6 AN to M10x1.5mm Metric Adapter
description:
The -6 AN to M10x1.5mm Metric Adapter is a high-performance component engineered for demanding automotive applications. ColorFittings AN to Metric Adapter and Union Fittings are precision-engineered to connect metric female ports to AN flare fittings, providing a secure, leak-free solution for fuel, oil, coolant, and power steering plumbing systems.

Each adapter is CNC machined from 6061-T6 billet aluminum and finished with ColorFittings' proprietary polishing and anodizing process for maximum strength, corrosion resistance, and long-term durability. These fittings are designed to withstand high pressure and high temperature environments commonly found in racing, street performance, marine, and aviation applications.

their AN to Metric Adapters are manufactured to provide a perfect fit and seal when paired with ColorFittings AN fittings, which are specifically engineered for use with E85, ethanol-based fuels, and race fuels. When combined with their nylon or stainless steel braided hose, these adapters deliver reliable performance and clean routing for any high-performance plumbing system.

Technical Specifications:
• Construction: Precision machined for rigorous track and street applications.
